pages.title: Where to find
pages.text: Native sleep rejects damage. Thrusts, side strikes and grabs require different movement: sidestep a thrust and leave a sweep’s reach. Avoid staying in front during a grab wind-up; retaliate after the sequence ends.

pages.title: How to fight
pages.text: This profile does not use hosted preparation. Fight it normally rather than looking for Start. Defeating this enemy contributes to world-tier progression.

pages.title: What does not work
pages.text: This profile does not use hosted preparation. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory.

pages.title: Drops
pages.text: Native loot for this encounter includes: Metal Debris, Somber Key Ring. Inspect the obtained item’s uses in JEI to choose your next equipment. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory.
